messages:
anya: heads-up — planning a small, backwards-compatible shim for client-side routing fallbacks. want opinions before i open the PR.

sam: curious — what's the exact problem we're trying to solve here?

anya: some apps hit Dedicated capacity and our router returns a 429 + route-change hint. clients today do nothing useful; they just fail.

anya: proposal: add an opt-in header X-RI-Policy that lets the SDK attach a policy token (e.g. 'fallback=regional,prefer-cheap') and SDKs implement a local fallback loop for one retry to an alternate endpoint.

lucas: implementation detail question: how do we avoid leaking the policy in logs/telemetry?

maria: we should send policy as hashed token in telemetry and only plain in outgoing request header. telemetry field = ri.policy_hash or similar.

sam: +1 on hashed telemetry. also need a console dashboard column for "client policy" so SRE/customer can see which policy was used for requests in a canary.

jeff: can we do examples? small py/ts snippets would help adoption.

anya: sure. python example: 
```
# set fallback policy on client
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., policy='fallback=regional,prefer-cheap')
resp = client.generate('tell me a joke')
```
ts example: 
```ts
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RI_KEY, policy: 'fallback=regional,prefer-cheap' })
await c.chat.create({ messages })
```

lucas: what about opt-in/opt-out semantics? default should be off for GA to avoid surprise behavior.

anya: agreed — default off. we add a feature flag in SDKs and a server-side kill switch in case of misbehaving clients.

maria: rollout plan idea: feature flag + canary in console (per-team opt-in). expose a toggle in the UI under Routes -> Client Policies. telemetry gated to opt-in.

sam: test matrix: python/ts/go, hosted+dedicated, with/without kvcache. also add an integration test that asserts only one retry occurs and telemetry records policy_hash.

jeff: are there any security concerns if customers put tenant-specific tokens in policy?

anya: we'll validate token format server-side and refuse tokens longer than 256 chars. also doc that tokens shouldn't contain PII.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/cli-policy-shim -> staging (pipeline #4521)

lucas: docs needed: migration guide, examples in SDK READMEs, and a short console UX doc for support.

maria: i'll draft console toggle copy and the dashboard column mock. can someone file the PR labels for docs + sdk?

anya: i'll open the SDK PRs after we agree on header name and telemetry field. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
